rows.ja: 決済・地図・クラウド

relations.text: DoorDashはPayPalとStripeとの商業契約に基づき決済処理を受けており、各社は事前通知で関係を終了できる
relations.text_en: Under its commercial agreements with Stripe and PayPal, each may terminate its relationship with DoorDash on advance notice

source.label: DoorDash 10-K
source.quote: Under our commercial agreements with Stripe and PayPal, each of these parties may terminate our relationship with advanced notice.

relations.text: Google Mapsなどの連携を利用し、依存している
relations.text_en: DoorDash integrates with or relies on Google Maps

source.label: DoorDash 10-K
source.quote: We also have integrations with or otherwise utilize or rely on PayPal, Stripe, Olo, Google Maps, Amazon Web Services ("AWS"), and a variety of other third-party vendors.

relations.text: 約2,700店のKroger系列店で、DoorDash MarketplaceのSNAP/EBT決済を開始した
relations.text_en: DoorDash launched SNAP/EBT payment capabilities at nearly 2,700 Kroger Family of Companies stores on the DoorDash Marketplace

source.label: DoorDash — Kroger SNAP / EBT launch, May 1, 2026
source.label_en: DoorDash — Kroger SNAP / EBT launch, May 1, 2026
source.quote: DoorDash, the local commerce platform, today announced the launch of SNAP/EBT payment capabilities to nearly 2,700 Kroger Family of Companies stores spanning banners like Mariano’s, Fred Meyer, Ralphs, and Harris Teeter on the DoorDash Marketplace.

relations.text: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.が管理代理人を務める修正再録リボルビング・クレジット契約(2022年8月7日付)の修正契約(2022年10月31日付)がある
relations.text_en: DoorDash has an amendment dated October 31, 2022 to its Amended and Restated Revolving Credit and Guaranty Agreement dated August 7, 2022 with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent

source.label: DoorDash 10-K
source.quote: 10.18 Amendment Agreement, dated as of October 31, 2022, relating to the Amended and Restated Revolving Credit and Guaranty Agreement among the registrant, the guarantors party thereto, the lenders party thereto, and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent, dated as of August 7, 2022.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.が管理代理人を務めるリボルビング・クレジット契約(2020年8月7日付)がある
relations.text_en: DoorDash has a Revolving Credit and Guaranty Agreement dated August 7, 2020 with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent

source.label: DoorDash 10-K
source.quote: 10.17 Amended and Restated Revolving Credit and Guaranty Agreement among the registrant, the guarantors party thereto, the lenders party thereto, and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent, dated as of August 7, 2020.

companies.name: ウーバー・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: ウーバー・テクノロジーズの年次報告が、DoorDashを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Uber's annual report names DoorDash as a competitor

source.label: Uber Technologies 10-K
source.quote: Our Delivery offering competes with numerous companies in the meal, grocery and other delivery space in various regions for Drivers, consumers, and merchants, including DoorDash, Instacart, Gopuff, Rappi, Delivery Hero, Just Eat Takeaway, and Amazon.

relations.text: DoorDashの年次報告が、Uber Eatsを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: DoorDash's annual report names Uber Eats as a competitor

source.label: DoorDash 10-K
source.quote: Globally, we compete with other local on-demand delivery companies, including Amazon, Uber Eats, Prosus, Delivery Hero, and other local incumbents.
